messages:
carmen: Quick follow-up from P-367 postmortem (recurring kv-cache evictions). Need owners, short deadlines, and discrete runbook/playbook updates (triage steps, copy-paste commands, escalation ladder). PM notes: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-367 :link:

josh: I'll take the config tuning + canary. Plan: reproduce in staging by Mon, open config PR Wed, small canary Fri.

anya: I'll own the runbook edits. Will add a 4-step first-responder checklist and exact kubectl/promtool commands. PR target: Thu AM.

lee: I'll handle alerts: two severities on cache_eviction_rate (WARN 2x baseline -> #incidents; SEV 5x baseline -> page SRE + Dedicated lead). Add recurrence rule: SEV 3x in 14d -> auto-ticket + retro. PR by Wed.

oncall-bot: Oncall SRE = @anya today. Paging policy: P1 -> 5m ack -> escalate to Dedicated.

josh: Proposed triage snippet to paste into runbook:

```bash
# check eviction metric
kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pods -l app=kv-cache -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- sh -c "curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/metrics | grep cache_eviction_rate"

# bump cache entries and restart
kubectl patch configmap cache-config -p '{"data":{"max_entries":"210000"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache

# quick rollback (apply last known good)
kubectl apply -f gitops/cache-configs/previous-good.yaml && kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
```

anya: Good. I'll include the snippet, a one-line rationale, and an explicit escalation ladder: responder -> SRE oncall (5m) -> Dedicated lead (10m) -> Eng infra (20m). Also include fallback: switch routing to `redwood-small` if tail p99 > 600ms for 2m.

lee: For alerts I'll add prom rules and an automation: when SEV fires 3x in 14d create INC ticket + assign owners from this thread.

carmen: Agreed owners & deadlines:
- josh: reproduce staging Mon; config PR Wed; canary Fri
- anya: runbook/playbook PR Thu AM
- lee: alerts + recurrence rule PR Wed

carmen: I'll run weekly 30m sync with owners until actions closed. Please react with :white_check_mark: to accept. I'll close this thread when PRs and ticket number are posted.
